description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade ZavaAuditWorker to the latest .NET LTS runtime and SDK-style project format.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested modernization to the latest framework before cloud migration work.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the current .NET Framework 4.8 worker to .NET 10 (latest LTS), including project format modernization needed for subsequent Azure SDK-based migrations.

tasks.description: Modernize core messaging and data integrations to Azure cloud-native managed services.
tasks.reason: The user requested cloud-native service modernization as part of Azure adoption.
tasks.requirements: Migrate queue processing from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus and database connectivity from existing SQL Server integration to Azure SQL Database, using Managed Identity-based authentication patterns for service access.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate dependency CVEs before deployment.
tasks.reason: Security and vulnerability remediation is required in every modernization plan before go-live.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate any identified vulnerabilities. Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to minimum patched versions, document major-version remediation risk when applicable, and verify build/test health after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized worker to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The modernization goal explicitly includes Azure deployment and defaults to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.requirements: Containerize and deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps using managed identity-first configuration and production-ready deployment settings.
